description: Header file defining the LocalTracer class and related classes for messaging and tracing in the Thunder project.

classes.name: LocalTracer
classes.description: Main class for managing message tracing, callbacks, and thread handling within the Thunder messaging framework.

classes.name: LocalTracer::ICallback
classes.description: Interface for callback implementations to handle trace messages.

classes.name: LocalTracer::MessageSettings
classes.description: Singleton class for managing message unit settings.

classes.name: LocalTracer::WorkerThread
classes.description: Worker thread class for dispatching messages.

classes.name: LocalTracer::ConsolePrinter
classes.description: Implementation of ICallback that outputs trace messages to the console.

methods.name: LocalTracer::Open
methods.description: Creates or retrieves the singleton instance of LocalTracer, initializing message unit and directory.

methods.name: LocalTracer::Close
methods.description: Closes and cleans up the LocalTracer instance, releasing resources.

methods.name: LocalTracer::EnableMessage
methods.description: Enables or disables tracing for a specific module and category.

methods.name: LocalTracer::Dispatch
methods.description: Processes incoming messages and calls the registered callback.

methods.name: LocalTracer::Callback
methods.description: Sets the callback object for message notifications.
